instruction: As a job posting for a SaaS backend engineer role, improve the specificity of the tech stack, the sense of ownership offered, and the overall appeal to candidates.

If you think you might be a good fit, please send us your resume and we will get back to you when we have reviewed the applications received.

instruction: As a scout email to a candidate for an advertising agency sales role, improve the sense of personalization, the concreteness of the appeal, and the clarity of the call to action.

There is no pressure at all, just an opportunity to learn about what we do. Let us know if you are available and we can figure out a time that works for both of us. Looking forward to hearing back from you.

instruction: As a rejection letter for a barista position at a cafe chain, improve the consideration shown to the applicant, move away from generic boilerplate phrasing, and leave the door open for future contact.

instruction: As a company introduction page for a trucking and logistics company, improve the demonstration of industry strengths, the persuasiveness of concrete numbers, and the appeal to prospective employees.

instruction: As the introduction to an employee interview feature for a caregiver at an elder care facility, improve the hook that draws reader interest, the specificity, and the sense of realism about the workplace.
